summary: 8 TCs reviewed; 0 real defects. Two-path connect: public_token exchange (lines 90-124) AND direct api_key paste (lines 126-137). _plaid_env() defaults sandbox; _plaid_base_url() composes f'https://{env}.plaid.com'. _plaid_creds raises 'plaid_not_configured' when PLAID_CLIENT_ID/SECRET unset (lines 56-65). Exchange error handling: 4xx → 'exchange_failed' with code+text (lines 98-102), httpx.HTTPError → 'plaid_unreachable' (lines 106-109). Both paths call store_api_key with proper scopes. Sync truncates accounts to 10 in config (line 178); mark_error on failure (line 164); mark_synced on success (line 181).
notes: Plaid access_tokens are LONG-LIVED (no expiry) — by design, no refresh path. Verified.
decrypt(creds.encrypted_key) on every sync — access tokens encrypted at rest via auth.crypto.encrypt during store_api_key.
First-10-accounts truncation in summary config keeps row size bounded for chat context.
